obligations.note: The change adds `if payee.category == "tax_authority": continue` in purge_due, creating a permanent exemption from NPI purging for an entire class of closed payee accounts. RET-1 requires that NPI of closed payee accounts IS purged after the approved retention period, with legal hold as the only carve-out. No category-based exemption exists in the obligation, and no approved exception in the register covers this deviation.

The change deviates from RET-1 by exempting tax_authority payees from the purge schedule. No entry in the exception register addresses RET-1 for the payments.retention component; the only payments-related exception (EXC-0141) is for SES-1 and expired in 2026-09-08.

No acceptance-ledger entry covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/retention.py; no prior evidence lapses as a result of this change.

summary: The change adds a permanent exemption in the retention purge job that prevents NPI of any payee with category 'tax_authority' from ever being purged, regardless of the retention period. This directly contradicts RET-1, which mandates that NPI of closed payee accounts be purged after the approved retention period with legal hold as the sole carve-out. No approved exception in the exception register covers RET-1 for the payments.retention component, so EXC-1 is also unmet. All change-management process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, LAP-1) are satisfied, but the product-obligation violation is critical and must be resolved—either by obtaining a properly approved, scoped exception with a compensating control, or by removing the unconditional exemption—before this change can be accepted.
